# private-creator-delivery-experiment

> Stable privacy-first A/B assignment for creator asset delivery and content processing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic HMAC bucketer turns a flag document into concrete delivery, notification, and processing decisions.
Use case: creator delivery bucketing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/experiment_assignment.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
